title: BUGFIX — Sweep remaining /record <id> 0 occurrences missing tiktok_url placeholder
rationale: Sprint 1373 fixed cmd-delivery.ts, Sprint 1379 fixed posting-auto-deliver.ts. But grep found 5 more occurrences still using /record <id> 0 without <tiktok_url>: posting-reminder.ts (2 files), weekend-blitz.ts, cmd-content.ts (x2), and telegram-bot.ts (inline 'posted:' callback that auto-records with no URL). All need the URL placeholder added. The telegram-bot.ts callback is special — it currently auto-records with no URL when operator taps 'Posted' button; should instead send a prompt asking for the URL.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/posting-reminder.ts:133, scripts/scs001/weekend-blitz.ts:224, scripts/posting-reminder.ts:193, scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-content.ts:289 and :311: change '/record ${videoId} 0' to '/record ${videoId} 0 <tiktok_url>'.

In scripts/telegram-bot.ts: the 'posted:' callback auto-calls handleCommand('/record ${videoId} 0') with no URL. Change to send a Telegram message prompting operator to run '/record ${videoId} 0 <tiktok_url>' instead of auto-recording.
